description: Routes the reSpeaker Living Room satellite's TTS reply URI (esphome.tts_uri event) to the resolver 'say' (play_media on media_player.ceiling_speakers). Slice 3 of S1b-2 - HA-automation only, no firmware. Reply plays on the ceiling; the satellite's local playback is silent (no speaker). continue_on_error so a long blocking reply does not mark the automation failed.
